pkgmetadata.longdescription: Opt-in configuration package for machines that run Steam (HOGSMEADE). Registers the third-party steam-overlay in /etc/portage/repos.conf and installs package.use (abi_x86_32 for the libraries the 32-bit Steam client and the NVIDIA driver need), package.accept_keywords and package.license entries. games-util/steam-launcher itself is installed from steam-overlay afterwards. Not part of any Horcrux image or profile.
